title: Law to ban license plate readers in taxis and limos
summary: This bill would prohibit drivers and owners of taxi and limousine commission-licensed vehicles from using automatic license plate readers in or on such vehicles. It would also bar base stations and dispatch services from requiring or encouraging their use. Violators face civil penalties of $500 for drivers and owners and $2,000 for base stations or dispatch services, with possible license suspension or revocation after three violations in 36 months.
